synopsis: Lor'themar, Halduron, Rommath, Liadrin, and the rest of Silvermoon's leadership finally decide that Kael'thas can no longer be trusted. Allegiance to the prince is severed, blood elf forces still loyal to Silvermoon are ordered to treat his faction in Outland as hostile, and Falanaras watches a people already wounded by history endure the loss of yet another sacred thing. Many citizens refuse to accept the news, still imagining Outland as a pilgrimage and promised land, while the magisters answer pro-Kael'thas agitation and public unrest with arrests, martial force, and tightening control.
title: Chapter 15: Oaths Severed
